LivingWorld : va manger de la viande au sol (sous-état .LivingWorldScavenge). C'est ce repas, et non la mise à mort, qui rend de la satiété.
LivingWorld : viande à portée → la mange (l'objet disparaît). Portée élargie à 2.5 blocs : un gros prédateur (ours) est trop large pour s'approcher à moins de 1.6 blocs.

LivingWorld : la viande a disparu (mangée par un autre, ramassée…).

LivingWorld : Predator affamé avec une proie (Prey/PreyBig) à portée → attaque immédiate. Placé avant la détection standard, qui ne ferait que passer en Alerted (les proies sont Neutral pour les prédateurs). Une fois la proie tuée, il mange la viande qu'elle lâche.

LivingWorldHungerThreshold.Description: LivingWorld : sous cette satiété (0-100), le prédateur part en chasse.

LivingWorldWakeThreshold.Description: LivingWorld : sous cette satiété, un prédateur endormi se réveille pour chasser.

LivingWorldMeatSearchRange.Description: LivingWorld : distance à laquelle il repère de la viande au sol.

LivingWorldMeatAmount.Description: LivingWorld : satiété regagnée par morceau de viande mangé.

LivingWorldHuntRange.Description: LivingWorld : distance à laquelle un prédateur affamé repère une proie et l'attaque. Doit rester > LivingWorldPredatorAlertRange (fuite des proies à 20 blocs) : sinon la proie fuit avant que la chasse ne démarre, le combat se termine en poursuite ratée, et le cycle recommence.

LivingWorldScentRange.Description: LivingWorld : distance à laquelle il flaire une proie et remonte sa piste.

LivingWorldProwlHeadingChange.Description: LivingWorld : changement de cap maximal (degrés) entre deux segments de patrouille. Faible = le prédateur garde sa direction et part loin de son spawn.

LivingWorldTrackSpeed.Description: LivingWorld : vitesse relative quand il suit une piste ou va vers de la viande.

ViewRange.Description: The range from which the target will be seen. If zero, sight will be disabled.

ViewSector.Description: The view sector within which the target needs to be to be seen.

HearingRange.Description: The range from which the target will be heard. If zero, hearing will be disabled.

AbsoluteDetectionRange.Description: The range at which a target is guaranteed to be detected. If zero, absolute detection will be disabled.

WebDetectionBlockSet.Description: Optional blockset that this NPC will passively detect steps on.

WebDetectionRange.Description: Detection range for the block step detection.

WebInvestigateRelativeSpeed.Description: The relative motion speed at which the NPC will investigate a stepped block

IdleDespawn.Description: Whether the NPC despawns after some time in the idle state

IdleDespawnTime.Description: The timeout before an NPC in the idle state despawns

AlertedRange.Description: A range within which the target can be seen/sensed when the NPC is alerted to their presence. Should be higher than sense ranges.

RunThreshold.Description: At what ratio NPC switches to run animation e.g MaxSpeed is 10, at RunThreshold 0.55 NPC will run at speed 5.5.

AlertedTimeout.Description: The time delay before an alerted NPC transitions to combat

AfraidItems.Description: The items the spider is afraid of

AfraidDistanceRange.Description: The distance the NPC will keep from targets holding items it's afraid of

AfraidAnimationFrequency.Description: The time delay between consecutive animations while in the afraid state

CombatMessageTargetGroups.Description: The NPC groups this NPC will warn when entering combat

CombatMovingRelativeSpeed.Description: Relative speed to use during combat specific movement (e.g. to achieve slower strafing).

AttackPauseRange.Description: The range for absolute minimum time before an NPC can execute a second attack.

CombatBehaviorDistance.Description: The distance within which to switch from smart chasing to combat-oriented movement behavior.

CombatDirectWeight.Description: Weight for the direct combat movement behavior (i.e. just going straight at the target, maintaining a close distance and attacking. Set to 0 to disable.

CombatStrafingDurationRange.Description: How long to strafe for when in the combat strafing movement behavior. Only applies if CombatStrafeWeight is greater than 0.

CombatStrafingFrequencyRange.Description: How frequently to strafe when in the combat strafing movement behavior. Only applies if CombatStrafeWeight is greater than 0.

HiddenUIComponents.Description: UI components hidden on this NPC.

ClimbHeight.Description: The maximum climb height, in blocks.

AscentAnimationType.Description: Animation when climbing up. Options: Walk, Jump, Climb, Fly, Idle.

DescendSpeedCompensation.Description: Factor to compensate forward speed reduction while moving downwards.

DescendFlatness.Description: Relative scale how fast NPC moves forward while climbing down.

DescentSteepness.Description: The relative steepness of the descent.

DescentBlending.Description: Blending of the descent pattern. 0 is linear, higher values more curved.

LeashDistance.Description: The range after which an NPC will start to want to return to their spawn point.

LeashDistanceReturn.Description: How close the NPC will want to get to the leash position before returning to idle

LeashRelativeSpeed.Description: The relative speed at which the NPC will return to its leash position

ConfusedTimeRange.Description: How long the NPC should act confused for when losing its target before beginning the search. While confused the NPC detection range is lowered.

SearchTimeRange.Description: How long the NPC should actively search for its lost target before giving up and going back to idle.

DisableDamageGroups.Description: Groups not to take damage from.

DeathParticles.Description: The particle system that spawns when the NPC's corpse disappears.

DropDeathItemsInstantly.Description: Whether the NPC's drop list should be executed when the NPC dies. If set to false, items drop when the corpse disappears.

DeathAnimationTime.Description: The time it takes for this NPC's corpse to disappear.

IsMemory.Description: Defines if the NPC is a memory

MemoriesCategory.Description: Defines the category of the memory

MemoriesNameOverride.Description: Overrides the memory name if set

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display

HitInterruptEnabled.Description: Whether hits can interrupt this NPC's melee attacks.

FlinchAnimation.Description: The flinch animation from this NPC's model.

StateTransitions.$Comment: Always clear animation when moving from Alerted state.
Always clear target and reset instructions when going back to idle.
